translations.team.title: Who you are talking to
translations.team.body: IDEM has two co-founders. Both are engineers, both are Cameroonian, and both answer their own email.
translations.team.arolle.bio: Senior software engineer. He decides what IDEM builds and what it refuses to build, and she knows the African entrepreneurial ecosystem from the inside.
translations.team.romuald.bio: DevSecOps engineer. He owns the infrastructure, the security of the platform and everything that has to keep running when traffic grows.
translations.video-trailer.simple_description: Watch how we transform ideas into complete applications
translations.about-page.hero.lede: Two engineers from Cameroon, one platform, and a single conviction: an entrepreneur in Yaoundé should not pay four times more than one in Paris for the same work.
translations.about-page.commitments.title: What we hold to
translations.about-page.commitments.body: World-class tools cost what a developer in San Francisco earns in an hour. That is the barrier. Everything below exists to lower it.
translations.about-page.values.title: Five words we are held to
translations.about-page.journey.title: One rung at a time
translations.about-page.vision.title: One million businesses that actually pay their founder
translations.about-page.vision.body: Not a million accounts created. A million African businesses that earn money, by 2035. That is the only figure we measure ourselves against.
translations.about-page.contact.title: Talk to us directly
translations.about-page.commitments.free.title: Start without paying
translations.about-page.commitments.free.description: Describe your project, see every deliverable, pay only for what you keep. No card asked for.
translations.about-page.commitments.price.title: Priced for the continent
translations.about-page.commitments.price.description: Three to five times below the international platforms, billed in CFA francs, paid by Mobile Money.
translations.about-page.commitments.open.title: Readable, forkable, yours
translations.about-page.commitments.open.description: The whole codebase is public, under Apache 2.0 with the Commons Clause. Audit it, run it on your own machine, deliver client work with it. Reselling IDEM itself is the one thing it rules out.
translations.about-page.values.sovereignty.title: African sovereignty
translations.about-page.values.sovereignty.descriptio: Every technical choice is weighed against one question: who keeps control of the code and the data.
translations.about-page.values.discipline.title: Discipline
translations.about-page.values.discipline.description: We ship what works. A feature that cannot be explained in one sentence is not finished.
translations.about-page.values.passion.title: Passion
translations.about-page.values.passion.description: We build for the entrepreneurs we grew up around, and we use the platform for our own company.
translations.about-page.values.patience.title: Patience
translations.about-page.values.patience.description: Infrastructure takes years. We would rather be solid in five years than loud this quarter.
translations.about-page.values.perseverance.title: Perseverance
translations.about-page.values.perseverance.descripti: Power cuts, payment rails, bandwidth. The obstacles are known, and none of them is a reason to stop.
translations.about-page.milestones.foundation.title: IDEM is founded in Douala
translations.about-page.milestones.foundation.descrip: Two co-founders, one question: why does a Cameroonian entrepreneur pay four times more for the same tooling?
translations.about-page.milestones.mvp.title: First public version
translations.about-page.milestones.mvp.description: Brand identity, business plan, website and go-live, generated end to end from a single description.
translations.about-page.milestones.openSource.title: The codebase goes public
translations.about-page.milestones.openSource.descrip: Everything released under Apache 2.0, with self-hosting documented so nobody depends on us to keep running.
translations.about-page.milestones.expansion.title: Hosting on the continent
translations.about-page.milestones.expansion.descript: Data centres and payment partners country by country, so latency and currency stop being obstacles.
translations.african-market-page.hero.lede: Africa has the youngest population on earth and the highest rate of people starting a business. What it does not have is tooling priced for it. That is the whole gap IDEM works in.
translations.african-market-page.figures.title: The market, in six numbers
translations.african-market-page.figures.sources: Sources: GSMA Mobile Economy Sub-Saharan Africa, ITU, Partech Africa Tech Venture Capital Report, IFC.
translations.african-market-page.why.title: Why here, why now
translations.african-market-page.why.body: None of this is a forecast. Mobile money, the median age and the number of registered small businesses are all measured today.
translations.african-market-page.difference.title: What an imported platform gets wrong
translations.african-market-page.difference.lede: The problem is rarely the model. It is the price, the currency, the payment rail and the assumption that your customers read English.
translations.african-market-page.rollout.title: Region by region
translations.african-market-page.rollout.payments: A region counts as open when you can pay from it. Mobile Money is live in thirteen countries; the rest follow their operators.
translations.african-market-page.cta.title: Your turn
translations.african-market-page.cta.body: Describe your business in a few sentences and see the brand, the plan and the site it produces. Nothing to pay to find out.
translations.african-market-page.stat.population.desc: Median age nineteen — the youngest population of any continent, heading for 2.5 billion by 2050.
translations.african-market-page.stat.internet.label: Internet users
translations.african-market-page.stat.internet.descri: Growing about ten percent a year, and overwhelmingly on a phone rather than a desktop.
translations.african-market-page.stat.smes.label: Small businesses
translations.african-market-page.stat.smes.descriptio: They account for roughly eighty percent of employment on the continent.
translations.african-market-page.stat.mobileMoney.des: Africa carries more mobile money traffic than the rest of the world put together.
translations.african-market-page.stat.entrepreneurshi: The highest rate of new business creation measured anywhere.
translations.african-market-page.stat.startups.label: Tech companies
translations.african-market-page.stat.startups.descri: Active across the continent, three times the count of 2020.
translations.african-market-page.reason.mobile.title: The phone is the computer
translations.african-market-page.reason.mobile.descri: Products designed desktop-first lose most of the market on the first screen. Everything in IDEM is built to be used from a phone.
translations.african-market-page.reason.mobile.eviden: More than eight in ten connections are mobile.
translations.african-market-page.reason.payment.title: Payment is the real barrier
translations.african-market-page.reason.payment.descr: A card-only checkout stops most would-be customers before the first screen. Topping up a wallet by Mobile Money does not.
translations.african-market-page.reason.payment.evide: Mobile Money live in thirteen countries, billed in CFA francs.
translations.african-market-page.reason.young.title: A generation starting out
translations.african-market-page.reason.young.descrip: Sixty percent of the continent is under twenty-five, and the people entering the workforce are the ones creating the businesses.
translations.african-market-page.reason.young.evidenc: Around 200 million young people join the workforce by 2035.
translations.african-market-page.reason.sovereignty.d: When the tool, the hosting and the invoice all sit abroad, every price rise and every policy change lands on the entrepreneur.
translations.african-market-page.reason.sovereignty.e: Apache 2.0, self-hostable, data exportable at any time.
translations.african-market-page.advantage.price.desc: Every country has its own grid, built from local purchasing power rather than converted from a single currency.
translations.african-market-page.advantage.payment.de: MTN and Orange Mobile Money top up the wallet, and the wallet pays for what you generate.
translations.african-market-page.advantage.language.d: French, English and Portuguese today. The deliverables follow the language of your request, not the language of the site.
translations.african-market-page.advantage.accounting: Financial statements follow the SYSCOHADA chart of accounts, so a loan officer in Abidjan or Douala can read them.
translations.african-market-page.advantage.sovereignt: Deploy to managed hosting, to your own VPS, or to a machine in your office. The choice stays yours.
translations.african-market-page.advantage.open.title: A platform you can audit
translations.african-market-page.advantage.open.descr: African developers can read the code, fix it and run it. That is what sovereignty means in practice.
translations.african-market-page.region.central.name: Central Africa
translations.african-market-page.region.central.descr: Our home market. We know the registry, the tax calendar and the banks because we went through them ourselves.
translations.african-market-page.region.central.count: Cameroon, Gabon, Congo, Chad, Central African Republic
translations.african-market-page.region.west.name: West Africa
translations.african-market-page.region.west.descript: The largest tech market on the continent, and the one where Mobile Money coverage is deepest.
translations.african-market-page.region.west.countrie: Nigeria, Ghana, Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Benin, Togo, Mali, Burkina Faso
translations.african-market-page.region.east.name: East Africa
translations.african-market-page.region.east.descript: The platform works today; what remains is a payment agreement with each operator so you can top up locally.
translations.african-market-page.region.south.name: Southern Africa
translations.african-market-page.region.south.descrip: The most mature infrastructure on the continent, and the market where we compete head-on with international platforms.
translations.african-market-page.region.south.countri: South Africa, Botswana, Namibia, Zambia, Zimbabwe

translations.builders-page.hero.lede: Idem Builders shows the projects that put Africa forward and that run on IDEM. Your project gets seen, and keeping it alive costs you less.
translations.builders-page.condition.title: One condition: run it with IDEM
translations.builders-page.condition.body: The programme is for projects that live on IDEM, not only projects that started there. One of these three is enough, and IDEM checks it for you when you apply.
translations.builders-page.condition.africa: Then the team looks at what the project brings to Africa: the people it serves, the problem it solves, where it is built.

translations.builders-page.way.deploy.description: Your website or app runs on IDEM hosting, published from iCode or from your own code.

translations.builders-page.steps.title: How to join
translations.builders-page.steps.body: Everything happens in your IDEM console. It takes a few minutes.
translations.builders-page.step.account.title: Sign in to IDEM
translations.builders-page.step.account.description: Create your account if you do not have one yet. It is free.
translations.builders-page.step.project.title: Pick your project
translations.builders-page.step.project.description: IDEM shows you right away whether it is run with IDEM, and what to do if it is not yet.
translations.builders-page.step.pitch.title: Tell us how it puts Africa forward
translations.builders-page.step.pitch.description: The problem you solve, for whom, where. A few lines are enough; this is what the team reads.
translations.builders-page.step.answer.title: Get the answer by email
translations.builders-page.step.answer.description: A person from the team reviews every application, within {$days} working days. Accepted, your benefits are active at once.

translations.builders-page.faq.title: Questions
translations.builders-page.faq.legal: The full rules are in the participation terms and the programme privacy policy, which you accept before applying.
translations.builders-page.faq.free.question: Does it cost anything?
translations.builders-page.faq.free.answer: No. Joining is free and does not oblige you to buy anything. The benefits apply to what you already use.
translations.builders-page.faq.several.question: Can I submit several projects?
translations.builders-page.faq.several.answer: Yes, one application per project. The welcome bonus is paid once per account; the other benefits apply to the whole account.
translations.builders-page.faq.refused.question: What if my application is not accepted?
translations.builders-page.faq.refused.answer: You receive the reason by email. Once the project has changed, you can apply again.
translations.builders-page.faq.leave.question: Can I leave the programme?
translations.builders-page.faq.leave.answer: At any time, by writing to us. You can also ask to hide your project from the showcase and stay a member.
translations.builders-page.cta.body: Run it with IDEM, tell us what it does for Africa, and we will show it.
translations.builders-page.showcase.emptyBody: Run your project with IDEM and tell us what it does for Africa.
translations.builders-page.cta.title2: Grow it here. We will make it known.
translations.builders-page.benefit.welcome.title: {$amount} F when you are accepted
translations.builders-page.benefit.welcome.body: Paid into your wallet once per account, for any IDEM service.
translations.builders-page.benefit.topup.title: +{$percent}% on every top-up
translations.builders-page.benefit.topup.body: Added on top of the tier bonus, for as long as you are a member.
translations.builders-page.benefit.hosting.title: -{$percent}% on hosting
translations.builders-page.benefit.hosting.body: The daily price of your iDeploy meters drops, for sites and apps alike.
translations.builders-page.benefit.showcase.body: Your project on idem.africa/builders, with its country and a link to it.
translations.builders-page.benefit.portrait.title: A feature by the team
translations.builders-page.benefit.portrait.body: Selected projects are told on the IDEM blog and social channels, prepared with you.
translations.builders-page.benefit.badge.body: For your own site: it shows you belong and links back here.
translations.builders-page.proof.badge: Your badge, ready to paste on your site
translations.builders-page.showcase.previewTagline: One sentence on what it does, and for whom.
translations.contact-page.hero.lede: A question about the platform, a quote for your company, a partnership: write to us and a founder reads it. Replies go out within one working day.
translations.contact-page.form.title: Write to us
translations.contact-page.form.body: Tell us what you are building and where you are stuck. The more concrete the message, the more useful the answer.
translations.contact-page.sent.title: Your message is on its way
translations.contact-page.sent.body: We read every message ourselves. Expect a reply within one working day, at the address you gave.
translations.contact-page.field.name: Your name
translations.contact-page.field.subject: What about
translations.contact-page.form.note: We use your address to reply, and for nothing else.
translations.contact-page.faq.title: Asked before you
translations.contact-page.cta.title: Or skip the conversation
translations.contact-page.cta.body: Creating a project and seeing what IDEM produces costs nothing, and takes about as long as writing this message.
translations.contact-page.channel.email.label: Email
translations.contact-page.channel.email.detail: The fastest route. A founder reads it.
translations.contact-page.channel.phone.label: Phone and WhatsApp
translations.contact-page.channel.office.label: Office
translations.contact-page.channel.office.detail: Come by if you are in town — tell us first.
translations.contact-page.channel.code.label: Issues and code
translations.contact-page.channel.code.detail: A bug or a feature request belongs here, in the open.
translations.contact-page.faq.delay.question: How long until someone replies?
translations.contact-page.faq.delay.answer: One working day for a written message. If it is urgent, call the number above — it rings on a founder's phone.
translations.contact-page.faq.enterprise.question: Can IDEM run inside my company?
translations.contact-page.faq.enterprise.answer: Yes. The licence lets you install the whole platform on your own servers, for your own company. Tell us your constraints and we will say what it takes.
translations.contact-page.faq.payment.question: How do I pay from my country?
translations.contact-page.faq.payment.answer: Mobile Money in thirteen African countries, or card. The wallet is topped up in CFA francs and spent as you generate.
translations.contact-page.faq.support.question: What help comes with a paid plan?
translations.contact-page.faq.support.answer: Written support by email, priority on paid plans, and the documentation. Nothing is hidden behind a support contract.
translations.contact-page.faq.reseller.question: I build sites for clients. Can I resell IDEM?
translations.contact-page.faq.reseller.answer: Agencies and consultants work with us already. Write with the kind of clients you serve and we will set the terms together.
translations.contact-page.error.incomplete: Name, email, subject and message are needed before we can reply.
translations.contact-page.error.network: The message did not go through. Try again, or write straight to contact@idem.africa.
translations.ideploy-page.hero.lede: You write the code. iDeploy puts it online, gives it a secure web address, backs it up and watches it. Nothing to install, not a single command to type.
translations.ideploy-page.steps.title: Four steps, once
translations.ideploy-page.steps.body: After that, every change to your code ships on its own.
translations.ideploy-page.where.title: Our servers, or yours
translations.ideploy-page.where.lede: The same product either way. What changes is who owns the machine, and where your data sleeps.
translations.ideploy-page.guard.title: Protected and watched
translations.ideploy-page.guard.lede: Everything switches on from the interface. You never touch the server.
translations.ideploy-page.domain.title: An address people recognise
translations.ideploy-page.domain.lede: Every app gets a working {$START_TAG_STRONG}.idem.africa{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} address the moment it goes live, with its certificate. Point your own domain at it when you are ready — the interface walks you through it, registrar by registrar.
translations.ideploy-page.domain.body: HTTPS is issued and renewed for you. There is no certificate to buy, upload or remember to replace.
translations.ideploy-page.catalogue.title: The software your team already knows, installed in one click
translations.ideploy-page.catalogue.lede: WordPress, Odoo, n8n, Supabase, Nextcloud, Grafana: the open-source tools millions of teams run. iDeploy installs them on our servers or on yours, with an address and backups.
translations.ideploy-page.also.title: And also
translations.ideploy-page.price.title: Your first app is on us
translations.ideploy-page.price.lede: The free plan is enough for a real project in production, commercial use included. You pay the day you need more.
translations.ideploy-page.price.paid: Paid plans start at 2 999 F per month. Mobile Money accepted, no card required.
translations.ideploy-page.around.title: Where the code comes from
translations.ideploy-page.around.body: iDeploy hosts whatever you give it. If you have not written it yet, the rest of IDEM does that part.
translations.ideploy-page.step.connect.title: Connect your code
translations.ideploy-page.step.connect.description: From GitHub, GitLab or a Dockerfile. An app built with iCode arrives without any of that.
translations.ideploy-page.step.where.title: Choose where it runs
translations.ideploy-page.step.where.description: Our servers, or yours. The same product either way, and the choice can change later.
translations.ideploy-page.step.guard.title: Tick what you need
translations.ideploy-page.step.guard.description: Firewall, vulnerability scans, backups. Each one is a switch in the interface, not a config file.
translations.ideploy-page.step.live.title: It is live
translations.ideploy-page.step.live.description: A web address and its certificate, in under a minute. Every push after that deploys on its own.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.idem.title: IDEM infrastructure
translations.ideploy-page.fork.idem.description: You look after nothing. We pick the machine, maintain it and replace it if it fails.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.idem.care: Updates, security and replacement after a failure: ours.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.idem.data: Hosted on IDEM infrastructure, under your plan.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.idem.fit: You want it to run without thinking about it.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.own.title: Your own server
translations.ideploy-page.fork.own.description: Plug your VPS in once with an SSH key. iDeploy installs it, secures it and keeps it current.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.own.machine: Your VPS, plugged in once with an SSH key. No server yet? iDeploy rents one for you.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.own.care: iDeploy installs it, secures it and keeps it current.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.own.fit: You already have a server, or your data has to stay with you.
translations.ideploy-page.guard.firewall.title: Firewall and WAF
translations.ideploy-page.guard.firewall.description: Block an address or a whole country, throttle the request rate, from the interface.
translations.ideploy-page.guard.scans.title: Scans before release
translations.ideploy-page.guard.scans.description: Code quality and known vulnerabilities are checked on every build. If the check fails, nothing ships.
translations.ideploy-page.guard.monitoring.title: Monitoring
translations.ideploy-page.guard.monitoring.descriptio: Requests, CPU, memory and disk, read continuously for your apps and your servers.
translations.ideploy-page.guard.alerts.title: Alerts where you already talk
translations.ideploy-page.guard.alerts.description: When something breaks, the message arrives in the channel your team is already in.

translations.ideploy-page.extra.team.description: Invitations, roles and variables shared across the team.

translations.ideploy-page.ecosystem.idem.name: The IDEM platform
translations.ideploy-page.ecosystem.idem.description: Brand, business plan, finances and legal papers — the business the application belongs to.
translations.idev-page.hero.lede: Describe what you need in your own words. iCode writes the React code, runs it in front of you in the browser, and keeps changing it as you talk. The source code is yours to export.
translations.idev-page.targets.title: Three things it can build
translations.idev-page.steps.title: How a session goes
translations.idev-page.steps.body: There is no project setup, no repository to create and no build to configure. The first message is the first step.
translations.idev-page.preview.title: It runs while it is being written
translations.idev-page.preview.lede: The project runs in your browser — Node, the dev server and a real database, with nothing installed on your machine.
translations.idev-page.ship.title: Online in one move, or gone with you
translations.idev-page.ship.lede: « Put it online » hands the project to iDeploy and gives you an address — a static site or a full stack with its database, no GitHub account required. Or export the folder and host it wherever you like.
translations.idev-page.around.title: What comes before and after
translations.idev-page.around.body: iCode writes the application. The rest of the business — the brand, the plan, the address, the hosting — is the rest of IDEM.
translations.idev-page.target.site.title: A showcase site
translations.idev-page.target.site.description: Pages that present your business and bring in enquiries. Built from your brand if you already made one with IDEM.
translations.idev-page.target.web.title: A web application
translations.idev-page.target.web.description: Accounts, forms, a database, pages that do work. The kind of tool you would otherwise run on a spreadsheet.
translations.idev-page.target.mobile.title: A phone application
translations.idev-page.target.mobile.description: Laid out for a phone, installable straight from its link, and packaged for Android and iOS from the same code.
translations.idev-page.step.describe.title: Say what you need
translations.idev-page.step.describe.description: Plain sentences, in French or English. « A booking page for my salon, with the opening hours and a deposit » is enough to start.
translations.idev-page.step.build.title: Watch it get written
translations.idev-page.step.build.description: Files appear one after another and the preview reloads as they land. You can read every line while it happens.
translations.idev-page.step.adjust.title: Change it by talking
translations.idev-page.step.adjust.description: « Move the price above the photo », « add a second language ». No file to find, no code to edit by hand unless you want to.
translations.idev-page.step.ship.title: Put it online
translations.idev-page.step.ship.description: One button hands the project to iDeploy and returns a working address with HTTPS. Or export the source and host it yourself.
translations.idev-page.preview.container.title: Node runs in the tab
translations.idev-page.preview.container.description: The dev server starts inside your browser. Nothing to install, and the preview is the real project rather than a picture of it.
translations.idev-page.preview.database.title: A real database in the preview
translations.idev-page.preview.database.description: Postgres runs alongside the app, so sign-up, saved records and queries work before anything is deployed.
translations.idev-page.preview.fullstack.title: Front and back together
translations.idev-page.preview.fullstack.description: A full-stack project runs its interface and its API side by side, the way it will run in production.
translations.idev-page.preview.errors.title: Errors come with a fix
translations.idev-page.preview.errors.description: When the build or the page breaks, the error is shown with a « Fix » button that hands it back to the model with the stack trace.
translations.idev-page.preview.phone.title: A phone frame for phone apps
translations.idev-page.preview.phone.description: Mobile projects preview inside an iPhone and an Android mockup, because a phone layout cannot be judged in a desktop window.
translations.idev-page.preview.code.title: The code is not hidden
translations.idev-page.preview.code.description: Open the editor, read any file, edit it directly. The conversation and the editor work on the same project.
translations.idev-page.ecosystem.idem.name: The IDEM platform
translations.idev-page.ecosystem.idem.description: Brand, business plan, finances, legal papers and communication — everything the application is the front of.
translations.idev-page.ecosystem.ideploy.description: Hosting, domain name, certificates and logs, on our machines or on yours.
translations.idomain-page.apps.body: In iDeploy as in iCode, you buy the name without leaving your application: it connects itself to the site you have just put online. No redirection, no second account, the same wallet.
translations.idomain-page.apps.title: Already online with IDEM?
translations.idomain-page.ecosystem.icode.description: The site or the application the name is for — written, then put online, then named.
translations.idomain-page.ecosystem.ideploy.descripti: The hosting the name points at. Buy the name from inside iDeploy and it connects itself.
translations.idomain-page.guarantee.holder.descriptio: You are the registered holder. Ask for the transfer code and we hand it over, free of charge — that is the only real guarantee there is.
translations.idomain-page.guarantee.holder.title: The name is yours, and it leaves with you
translations.idomain-page.guarantee.price.description: It is held for the whole of your order, even if a rate changes in between. The renewal price is shown before you pay, not a year later.
translations.idomain-page.guarantee.price.title: The price you saw is the price you pay
translations.idomain-page.guarantee.refund.descriptio: If someone registers it first, the amount goes back into your wallet automatically. You do not have to ask.
translations.idomain-page.guarantee.refund.title: Refunded if the name gets away
translations.idomain-page.guarantees.lede: The same price whenever you buy. What a registrar can promise is narrow, so here is exactly what we do promise — and the registration rules say the rest, including what we cannot change.
translations.idomain-page.guarantees.title: One price, and no surprises
translations.idomain-page.hero.lede: Buy your domain name from your IDEM wallet, in mobile money. It is registered in your name, connected to your site and secured with HTTPS — and you set nothing up.
translations.idomain-page.included.connect.descriptio: One move attaches the name to the site you just put online with iDeploy or iCode.
translations.idomain-page.included.connect.title: Connected to your application
translations.idomain-page.included.dns.description: Your site’s address is written and kept up to date. The advanced records are there if you want them, hidden if you do not.
translations.idomain-page.included.dns.title: DNS managed for you
translations.idomain-page.included.https.description: The padlock is obtained and renewed without you doing anything, for as long as the name is connected.
translations.idomain-page.included.https.title: Automatic HTTPS
translations.idomain-page.included.lede: Not an upsell list: everything below comes with the name, at the price shown.
translations.idomain-page.included.mail.description: Connecting your site touches only its address. Your e-mail and your other records are never overwritten.
translations.idomain-page.included.mail.title: Your mail stays where it is
translations.idomain-page.included.manage.description: State, deadline, advanced DNS, transfer code — in your language, in one screen.
translations.idomain-page.included.manage.title: One place for everything
translations.idomain-page.included.reminders.descript: You are warned ahead of time, with the renewal price. A name is not lost because an e-mail went missing.
translations.idomain-page.included.reminders.title: Reminders before the deadline
translations.idomain-page.included.title: Included with every name
translations.idomain-page.setup.body: You can close the page: the installation carries on without you, and you find its state again under « My domains ».
translations.idomain-page.setup.connected.description: The DNS records are written for you and your application answers to that name. You open no technical panel.
translations.idomain-page.setup.connected.title: Address written, site connected
translations.idomain-page.setup.paid.description: Debited from your IDEM wallet, topped up by mobile money. No card, no bank form.
translations.idomain-page.setup.paid.title: Payment received
translations.idomain-page.setup.registered.descriptio: You are the holder — not us. The name is yours, and you can take it to another registrar whenever you want.
translations.idomain-page.setup.registered.title: Name registered in your name
translations.idomain-page.setup.secured.description: The certificate is obtained and renewed on its own. Your visitors see a site they can trust.
translations.idomain-page.setup.secured.title: HTTPS padlock switched on
translations.idomain-page.setup.title: You pay. IDEM does the rest.
translations.ivision-page.around.body: Your IDEM account is enough: the same wallet and the same prices as in your dashboard. iVision makes the business known — the rest of the business is the rest of IDEM.
translations.ivision-page.around.title: One account, one wallet
translations.ivision-page.brand.lede: Paste your site’s address. iVision reads its colours, its fonts, its logo and its tone, and uses them from the next creation onwards. A brand is never required: you can produce a video with no project, no charter and no logo.
translations.ivision-page.brand.title: Your website becomes your brand guide
translations.ivision-page.capabilities.title: What it does that a template cannot
translations.ivision-page.capability.creativity.descr: Four notches, from a plain composition to a real piece of authored work. The notch picks the range of templates it draws from.
translations.ivision-page.capability.creativity.title: A gauge for how far it goes
translations.ivision-page.capability.formats.descript: The same film laid out for a feed, a story and a screen. You do not reframe anything by hand.
translations.ivision-page.capability.formats.title: Every format, one request
translations.ivision-page.capability.montage.descript: Import a video of you talking. iVision cuts the silences and the hesitations, adds the subtitles, and makes what you say appear on screen.
translations.ivision-page.capability.montage.title: Film yourself, it edits
translations.ivision-page.capability.photos.descripti: No filter, no duotone, no tracing. What you upload is what is shown — a check in the code makes sure of it.
translations.ivision-page.capability.photos.title: Your photos stay your photos
translations.ivision-page.capability.stencil.descript: A video or a poster you like? Add it. iVision takes its cutting, its movements and its composition — with your texts, your images and your music.
translations.ivision-page.capability.stencil.title: Show it a model, it copies it
translations.ivision-page.capability.voice.descriptio: Dictate your request. It is transcribed on our own machines — the recording never leaves for a third party, and it is deleted as soon as the text exists.
translations.ivision-page.capability.voice.title: Speak instead of typing
translations.ivision-page.ecosystem.icode.description: The website or the application the videos point to — written from the same brand.
translations.ivision-page.ecosystem.idem.description: Brand charter, business plan, communication calendar. A charter made in IDEM is imported into iVision in one click.
translations.ivision-page.ecosystem.idem.name: The IDEM platform
translations.ivision-page.hero.lede: One sentence is enough. iVision makes the motion design video or the visual, in your colours, sized for every network — and you change it by clicking on it.
translations.ivision-page.step.brand.description: Paste your website’s address and iVision reads its colours, fonts, logo and tone. No site? « In blue and gold » in your request does the job.
translations.ivision-page.step.brand.title: It takes your colours
translations.ivision-page.step.edit.description: Click any text: the video jumps to the moment it appears and changes while you type. Do not like a photo? Replace it in one click.
translations.ivision-page.step.edit.title: Click, write, it is changed
translations.ivision-page.step.publish.description: Every network format at once, or the file on your machine. Nothing is published until you have approved it.
translations.ivision-page.step.publish.title: Publish, or download
translations.ivision-page.step.say.description: « A video for our end-of-year sale: 30 % off the whole shop, until 31 December. » One sentence is enough — written, or dictated.
translations.ivision-page.step.say.title: Say what you want to announce
translations.ivision-page.step.watch.description: Shots appear one after another, with their text, their images and their music. You see the film before it is finished.
translations.ivision-page.step.watch.title: Watch it get made
translations.ivision-page.steps.body: There is no timeline to learn and no software to install. The first sentence is the first step, and nothing is published without you.
translations.ivision-page.steps.title: How a request goes
translations.ivision-page.workshop.image.description: Posters, posts, stories, banners — composed to the millimetre and checked by eye before they are handed to you.
translations.ivision-page.workshop.image.title: Visuals
translations.ivision-page.workshop.video.description: Motion design from 6 to 60 seconds, with royalty-free music and sound effects. Or your own piece to camera, edited for you.
translations.ivision-page.workshop.video.title: Videos
translations.ivision-page.workshops.lede: One conversation makes visuals, another makes videos. Each keeps its own settings and its own history, so a poster never inherits a film’s choices.
translations.ivision-page.workshops.title: Two workshops, never mixed
translations.open-source-page.hero.lede: The whole platform is published under Apache 2.0 with the Commons Clause. Read it, fork it, run it on your own machine, build for your clients with it. None of that needs our permission.
translations.open-source-page.license.title: Apache 2.0, in plain words
translations.open-source-page.license.body: Four rights the licence grants you, and the one obligation it puts on you. The full text ships with the repository.
translations.open-source-page.data.title: Where your work actually sits
translations.open-source-page.data.lede: Three places, and you pick. The platform does not change behaviour depending on which one you choose.
translations.open-source-page.law.title: No lock-in to argue about
translations.open-source-page.law.lede: Every deliverable leaves as a file you own: the brand book as a PDF, the logo and its variants as a ZIP, the generated site and app as source code. What the platform keeps, and for how long, is written down — not described in a sales page.
translations.open-source-page.community.title: Decisions happen in the open
translations.open-source-page.community.body: The roadmap, the issues and the arguments are public. If a choice affects how your business runs, you get to be in the conversation.
translations.open-source-page.cta.title: Clone it, or just use it
translations.open-source-page.cta.body: Running IDEM yourself costs you a server. Running it here costs nothing until you keep something.
translations.open-source-page.clause.read.title: Read and audit all of it
translations.open-source-page.clause.read.description: Every line of the platform is public, including how your data is stored and which model handles which request.
translations.open-source-page.clause.host.title: Install it on your own servers
translations.open-source-page.clause.host.description: Run the whole platform inside your company, for your company. No licence fee, no call home.
translations.open-source-page.clause.clients.title: Deliver client work with it
translations.open-source-page.clause.clients.descript: Agencies and freelancers can use IDEM to build for their clients, and charge for that work as they always have.
translations.open-source-page.clause.modify.title: Change it and share the change
translations.open-source-page.clause.modify.descripti: Fork it, patch it, redistribute it, as long as the copyright notices stay in place.
translations.open-source-page.clause.sell.title: Resell IDEM itself
translations.open-source-page.clause.sell.description: The Commons Clause added to the licence rules out selling the software, or hosting it as a paid service of your own. Write to us if that is what you need.
translations.open-source-page.hosting.managed.title: Our managed hosting
translations.open-source-page.hosting.managed.descrip: The default. You create a project, we keep the machines running, and your deliverables are downloadable at any point.
translations.open-source-page.hosting.vps.title: Your own VPS
translations.open-source-page.hosting.vps.description: Point iDeploy at a server you rent and it builds there instead. The provider, the country and the invoice are yours.
translations.open-source-page.hosting.onPremise.title: A machine in your office
translations.open-source-page.hosting.onPremise.descr: The full platform installs from the repository with Docker. Nothing leaves the building, including the prompts.
translations.open-source-page.place.github.descriptio: The code, the issues and the roadmap. Pull requests are read.
translations.open-source-page.place.issues.name: Report a bug
translations.open-source-page.place.issues.descriptio: Open an issue on the repository. Bugs reported in the open get fixed in the open.
translations.open-source-page.place.releases.name: Release notes
translations.open-source-page.place.releases.descript: What changed, version by version, with the commits behind each line.

translations.pricing-page.hero.description: Create your business plan, logo, website and more for free. When you like the result, keep the final version from 500 F, paid by mobile money.
translations.pricing-page.hero.note: No bank card. 7 days of IDEM Growth offered at signup.
translations.pricing-page.detail.title: Every price, service by service
translations.pricing-page.pay.title: How to pay
translations.pricing-page.pay.s1d: By mobile money, from 100 F. Bonus: +5% from 5,000 F, +10% from 10,000 F.
translations.pricing-page.pay.s2d: A final version, a plan, a pack. The price is shown before you pay.
translations.pricing-page.pay.s3d: Files without the mark, your site online. A failed generation is refunded automatically.
translations.pricing-page.more.title: Other offers
translations.pricing-page.faq.title: Questions
translations.pricing-page.final.title: Start tonight, pay only if you keep it.
translations.pricing-page.detail.idemNote: Drafts are free. Once your purchases on a project reach 2,500 F, the rest of the Kit is unlocked.
translations.pricing-page.detail.commNote: Your purchases of the month stop at 3,000 F: beyond that, IDEM Growth is yours until month end.
translations.pricing-page.detail.icodeNote: Generating your app and watching it run is free.
translations.pricing-page.row.pass: Project Pass: code, GitHub, deploy, 30 changes
translations.pricing-page.detail.ideployNote: Paid by the day from your wallet. No subscription; an unpaid app falls asleep, it is never deleted.
translations.pricing-page.row.veille: Standby: online, woken up on visit
translations.pricing-page.detail.ivisionNote: Creating is free and marked “Made with iVision”. You pay for the HD file without the mark.
translations.pricing-page.detail.simNote: A free first analysis, then a full test of your business before you launch.
translations.pricing-page.more.entreprise: IDEM Business: everything in Growth, hosting of your app and iVision Creator
translations.pricing-page.more.createur: iVision Creator: every HD export of visuals and videos
translations.pricing-page.more.domaine: Launch Pack with a .africa domain for one year
translations.pricing-page.more.plusieurs: Together: 5 Launch Packs for an association or a tontine (the 5th is free)
translations.pricing-page.faq.q1: Why pay when ChatGPT is free?
translations.pricing-page.faq.a1: You do not pay to generate: drafts are free. You pay for a finished document, sourced, laid out and ready for the bank, adapted to OHADA law and your country.
translations.pricing-page.faq.a2: No. Plans are optional and your pay-as-you-go purchases stop at their price: you never pay more than the plan.
translations.pricing-page.faq.q3: Can I pay without a bank card?
translations.pricing-page.faq.a3: Yes. Everything is paid by mobile money, or with an IDEM code bought in cash from an agent.
translations.pricing-page.faq.a4: You are not charged: the amount goes back to your wallet automatically.
translations.pricing-page.faq.q5: What if my wallet is empty?
translations.pricing-page.faq.a5: Your drafts stay. A paid website falls asleep after a reminder e-mail and wakes up when you top up. Nothing is deleted.

translations.beta.overview.title: 1. BETA PROGRAM OVERVIEW
translations.beta.overview.content: Welcome to the IDEM Beta Program. By participating in this beta program, you agree to test our AI-powered project management platform and provide feedback to help us improve the service before its general release. This beta program allows you to access pre-release features and functionality that may not be available in the production version.
translations.beta.nature.title: 2. BETA SOFTWARE NATURE
translations.beta.nature.content: You acknowledge and understand that the beta software has the following characteristics:
translations.beta.nature.prerelease: Is pre-release software that may contain bugs, errors, defects, and security vulnerabilities
translations.beta.nature.malfunction: May not function as intended or may fail to function entirely
translations.beta.nature.crashes: May cause system crashes, data loss, corruption, or other unexpected issues
translations.beta.nature.testing_only: Is provided for testing, evaluation, and feedback purposes only
translations.beta.nature.limited_features: May have limited features, incomplete functionality, or missing documentation
translations.beta.nature.subject_to_change: Is subject to significant changes, modifications, or removal without notice
translations.beta.nature.performance_issues: May have performance issues, slow response times, or service interruptions
translations.beta.nature.warning.title: Important Beta Software Warning
translations.beta.nature.warning.content: Beta software is inherently unstable and should not be used for production purposes, critical business operations, or with sensitive data. Always maintain backups of important information.
translations.beta.limitations.title: 3. USAGE LIMITATIONS AND RESTRICTIONS
translations.beta.limitations.content: During the beta period, the following limitations and restrictions apply:
translations.beta.limitations.access.title: 3.1 Beta Access Limitations
translations.beta.limitations.access.content: Your access to the beta program is subject to the following conditions:
translations.beta.limitations.access.limited: Beta access is limited, invitation-only, and may be revoked at any time without notice
translations.beta.limitations.access.quotas: Usage quotas, rate limits, and resource restrictions may apply
translations.beta.limitations.access.restricted_featu: Certain features may be restricted, disabled, or unavailable
translations.beta.limitations.access.no_guarantee: Service availability, uptime, and performance are not guaranteed
translations.beta.limitations.access.account_reset: Beta accounts may be reset, modified, or deleted without notice
translations.beta.limitations.prohibited.title: 3.2 Prohibited Uses
translations.beta.limitations.prohibited.content: During the beta period, you explicitly agree NOT to:
translations.beta.limitations.prohibited.production: Use the beta software for production, commercial, or revenue-generating purposes
translations.beta.limitations.prohibited.sensitive_da: Process, store, or transmit sensitive, confidential, or critical business data
translations.beta.limitations.prohibited.mission_crit: Rely on the beta software for mission-critical operations or time-sensitive tasks
translations.beta.limitations.prohibited.reverse_engi: Reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble, or attempt to derive source code
translations.beta.limitations.prohibited.share_access: Share, transfer, or sublicense your beta access credentials with others
translations.beta.limitations.prohibited.circumvent: Attempt to circumvent usage limits, security measures, or access controls
translations.beta.limitations.prohibited.violate_laws: Use the beta software to violate any laws, regulations, or third-party rights
translations.beta.data_privacy.title: 4. DATA AND PRIVACY CONSIDERATIONS
translations.beta.data_privacy.content: Beta software involves special data handling and privacy considerations:
translations.beta.data_privacy.warning.title: Critical Data Warning
translations.beta.data_privacy.warning.content: Beta software may be unstable and could result in complete data loss. DO NOT input critical, sensitive, confidential, or irreplaceable data during the beta period. Always maintain external backups of important information.
translations.beta.data_privacy.data_deletion: Beta data may be deleted, reset, or corrupted at any time without notice or recovery
translations.beta.data_privacy.no_backup: Data backup, recovery, and retention services are not guaranteed or provided
translations.beta.data_privacy.monitoring: Your beta usage data, interactions, and feedback may be monitored and collected
translations.beta.data_privacy.error_logs: Error logs, crash reports, and diagnostic data may be automatically collected
translations.beta.data_privacy.different_policies: Beta data is not subject to the same security, privacy, or retention policies as production data
translations.beta.data_privacy.data_usage: We may use beta data to improve our services, train AI models, and develop new features
translations.beta.data_privacy.third_party_sharing: Beta data may be shared with third-party service providers for testing and development
translations.beta.feedback.title: 5. FEEDBACK AND REPORTING OBLIGATIONS
translations.beta.feedback.content: As a beta participant, you agree to actively participate in the following ways:
translations.beta.feedback.constructive: Provide constructive, detailed feedback about your experience and observations
translations.beta.feedback.report_bugs: Report bugs, errors, crashes, and issues promptly with reproduction steps
translations.beta.feedback.surveys: Participate in surveys, feedback sessions, and user research when requested
translations.beta.feedback.test_features: Test specific features, workflows, and scenarios as directed by our team
translations.beta.feedback.communication_channels: Communicate through designated beta feedback channels and platforms
translations.beta.feedback.suggestions: Provide suggestions for improvements, new features, and enhancements
translations.beta.feedback.document_use_cases: Document and share use cases, workflows, and integration scenarios
translations.beta.confidentiality.title: 6. CONFIDENTIALITY AND NON-DISCLOSURE
translations.beta.confidentiality.content: The beta software, your participation, and all related information are strictly confidential. You agree to:
translations.beta.confidentiality.keep_confidential: Keep all beta software features, capabilities, and functionality confidential
translations.beta.confidentiality.no_disclosure: Not disclose beta program details, information, or materials to unauthorized parties
translations.beta.confidentiality.no_publishing: Not publish reviews, blog posts, screenshots, videos, or demos without written permission
translations.beta.confidentiality.no_sharing: Not share beta access, credentials, or invitation codes with others
translations.beta.confidentiality.no_public_discussio: Not discuss beta features publicly on social media, forums, or other platforms
translations.beta.confidentiality.additional_agreemen: Respect any additional confidentiality agreements or non-disclosure requirements
translations.beta.confidentiality.return_materials: Return or destroy all beta materials upon request or program termination
translations.beta.duration.title: 7. BETA PROGRAM DURATION AND TERMINATION
translations.beta.duration.content: The beta program operates under the following terms:
translations.beta.duration.no_guarantee: Has no guaranteed duration, timeline, or end date and may conclude at any time
translations.beta.duration.termination: May be terminated by either party at any time without notice or explanation
translations.beta.duration.auto_end: Will automatically end upon general release, public launch, or program cancellation
translations.beta.duration.loss_of_access: May result in immediate loss of access to beta features, data, and materials
translations.beta.duration.cease_use: Requires you to cease all use and delete downloaded materials upon termination
translations.beta.duration.no_guarantee_transition: Does not guarantee transition to the production version or continued access

translations.buildersPrivacy.scope.content: This policy describes the personal data processed for the Idem Builders programme: your application, its review, the benefits granted and the public showcase. It supplements the IDEM Privacy Policy, which continues to apply to the rest of your use of IDEM.
translations.buildersPrivacy.controller.content: The data controller is IDEM, Douala, Cameroon. For any question about your data: legal@idem.africa.
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.identity: your IDEM account identifier, email address and display name;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.project: the project you submit: its name, description, country and public address;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.pitch: the text in which you explain how the project puts Africa forward;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.brand: the brand identity of the project created in IDEM (logo, colours, typefaces), read from the project when the page is displayed;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.cover: the cover image you upload, if any, resized and stripped of its metadata (including any location);
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.team: if you choose to publish it, the team entered in the project: name, role, short biography, photograph and professional links of each member;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.signals: a snapshot, taken on the day you apply, of what the project does with IDEM — only yes or no for each item (online with iDeploy, marketing in IDEM, domain, brand, business plan…), never the content of your documents;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.consent: the proof that you accepted the terms: version, date and time, IP address and browser identifier;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.decision: the decision: status, date, team member who decided and, in case of refusal, the reason;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.benefits: the benefits granted, recorded in your wallet history;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.emails: the sending record of the emails about your application (address, date, delivery status).
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.not.title: What we do not collect
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.not.content: The programme asks for no identity document, no bank or Mobile Money details and no information about your customers.
translations.buildersPrivacy.purposes.content: Each use has its own purpose and legal basis:
translations.buildersPrivacy.purposes.review: Reviewing your application and answering it — basis: your request and these terms.
translations.buildersPrivacy.purposes.benefits: Granting and applying the benefits (bonus, top-up credit, hosting discount) — basis: performance of the programme terms.
translations.buildersPrivacy.purposes.showcase: Publishing the project on the showcase and on its own page, with its team if you chose it — basis: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
translations.buildersPrivacy.purposes.emails: Writing to you about your application and the programme — basis: performance of the programme terms.
translations.buildersPrivacy.purposes.proof: Keeping the proof of your acceptance and preventing fraud (multiple accounts, fictitious projects) — basis: the legitimate interest of IDEM.
translations.buildersPrivacy.purposes.stats: Measuring the programme with aggregated statistics, which identify no one — basis: the legitimate interest of IDEM.
translations.buildersPrivacy.public.content: If your project is admitted, its page and the showcase show: its name, description, country and city, public address, your display name as the person behind it, date of admission, the text in which you present it, its cover image, its brand identity (logo, colours, typefaces) and the list of what it does with IDEM (online, marketing, brand, business plan…). The team appears only if you chose it, without email addresses. Your own email address, the reason for a decision and your proof of acceptance are never published. You can ask at any time to hide the project from the showcase, or to remove the team from its page.
translations.buildersPrivacy.recipients.team: The IDEM team members in charge of the programme, through the administration panel; their access requires authentication and their actions are logged.
translations.buildersPrivacy.recipients.providers: The technical providers IDEM relies on to host the platform and send emails, bound by confidentiality and acting only on IDEM instructions.
translations.buildersPrivacy.recipients.authorities: Public authorities, only when the law requires it.
translations.buildersPrivacy.recipients.nosale.title: No sale, no advertising
translations.buildersPrivacy.recipients.nosale.conten: Your data is never sold, rented or shared for advertising purposes.
translations.buildersPrivacy.hosting.content: Programme data is stored in the IDEM platform database, on the servers IDEM uses for the whole platform. When a provider processes data outside your country, IDEM requires contractual guarantees of a level of protection equivalent to this policy.
translations.buildersPrivacy.retention.refused: Application not admitted: 12 months after the decision, then deleted.
translations.buildersPrivacy.retention.member: Admitted application: for the whole membership, then 3 years after you leave the programme.
translations.buildersPrivacy.retention.proof: Proof of acceptance of the terms: 5 years after the end of your participation, to answer a possible dispute.
translations.buildersPrivacy.retention.ledger: Wallet entries for the credits granted: for the period required by accounting rules (10 years under OHADA accounting law).
translations.buildersPrivacy.security.content: Data travels encrypted (HTTPS). Access to the administration panel is restricted to authenticated team members, and each decision records who made it. The programme collects only what the review needs.
translations.buildersPrivacy.automated.content: Before you apply, IDEM automatically checks whether the project is run with IDEM. This check only opens or closes the application form; it never decides on admission. Every decision is taken by a person.
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.content: Under the applicable law, including Cameroon law no. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 on the protection of personal data, you have the right to:
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.access: access your data and obtain a copy of it;
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.erase: have it deleted, within the limits of the retention periods in section 8;
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.object: object to a processing based on legitimate interest, or ask for it to be limited;
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.withdraw: withdraw your consent to the showcase, or leave the programme, at any time;
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.portability: receive the data you provided in a common, readable format.
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.how.title: How to exercise them
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.how.content: Write to legal@idem.africa from the address of your IDEM account. IDEM answers within 30 days and may ask you to prove your identity. If you are not satisfied with the answer, you can lodge a complaint with the personal data protection authority of your country.
translations.buildersPrivacy.minors.content: The programme is open to adults only. IDEM deletes any application found to come from a minor.
translations.buildersPrivacy.changes.content: IDEM may update this policy. Substantial changes are announced by email and in the console before they apply. The version you accepted is recorded with your application.
translations.buildersPrivacy.contact.content: Personal data: legal@idem.africa. Programme: contact@idem.africa. IDEM, Douala, Cameroon.

translations.buildersTerms.purpose.content: These terms govern participation in Idem Builders, the programme run by IDEM (Douala, Cameroon) that showcases projects which put Africa forward and are run with IDEM. They come in addition to the IDEM Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, and to the Idem Builders Privacy Policy, which all continue to apply. Where a point is specific to the programme, these terms prevail. You accept them by ticking the box provided for that purpose before sending your application. IDEM records the version accepted, the date and time, your IP address and your browser identifier, as proof of that acceptance.
translations.buildersTerms.programme.content: Idem Builders is free. Applying does not oblige you to buy anything, and being admitted does not create any partnership, employment, sponsorship, investment, agency or exclusivity between you and IDEM. Admission is a recognition of your project and gives access to the benefits described in section 6, for as long as you remain a member.
translations.buildersTerms.eligibility.content: To apply, all of the following conditions must be met:
translations.buildersTerms.eligibility.account: You have an IDEM account in your own name and you are of legal age (18 or older).
translations.buildersTerms.eligibility.owner: You own the project you submit, or you are authorised to represent it.
translations.buildersTerms.eligibility.managed: The project is run with IDEM: it is online through iDeploy, or its marketing is managed in IDEM, or its domain name was registered through IDEM. IDEM checks this automatically before you can apply.
translations.buildersTerms.eligibility.africa: The project puts Africa forward: it serves African users, solves a problem faced in Africa, or is built and led from Africa.
translations.buildersTerms.eligibility.real: The project is real, active and lawful in the countries where it operates.
translations.buildersTerms.eligibility.excluded.title: Projects that cannot be admitted
translations.buildersTerms.eligibility.excluded.conte: Whatever their quality, the following are excluded:
translations.buildersTerms.eligibility.excluded.illeg: Activities that are illegal, or that require a licence the project does not hold (gambling, financial services, health products…).
translations.buildersTerms.eligibility.excluded.harm: Content that is hateful, violent, sexually explicit, discriminatory or that exploits minors.
translations.buildersTerms.eligibility.excluded.decep: Deceptive schemes: pyramid or Ponzi schemes, guaranteed returns, counterfeits, fake reviews.
translations.buildersTerms.eligibility.excluded.right: Projects that infringe a third party's rights (trademarks, copyright, image rights).
translations.buildersTerms.application.content: An application is made from the IDEM console, project by project.
translations.buildersTerms.application.accurate: The information you give must be accurate and must stay up to date. An application based on false information may be refused or withdrawn at any time.
translations.buildersTerms.application.one: Only one application can be open or accepted at a time for the same project.
translations.buildersTerms.application.more: The team may contact you by email to ask for details before deciding.
translations.buildersTerms.review.content: Every application is read and decided by a member of the IDEM team. The automatic check described in section 3 only decides whether you can apply; it never accepts or refuses an application on its own. The team considers how real and active the project is, how it uses IDEM, what it brings to Africa, and its compliance with these terms. IDEM aims to answer within five working days, without guaranteeing it. The decision is sent by email and shown in your console. A refusal comes with a reason; you may apply again once the project has changed. Admission is at the discretion of IDEM and is not a right.
translations.buildersTerms.benefits.content: Admission gives access to the following benefits, as published on the programme page on the day of admission:
translations.buildersTerms.benefits.welcome: A welcome bonus credited to your IDEM wallet when your first project is admitted — once per account, whatever the number of projects admitted.
translations.buildersTerms.benefits.topup: An extra credit on each wallet top-up made while you are a member, added to the tier bonus. It does not apply to top-ups made before admission.
translations.buildersTerms.benefits.hosting: A discount on the daily price of the iDeploy hosting tiers paid from your wallet. Options are charged at full price; days covered by a plan or by prepaid days are not affected.
translations.buildersTerms.benefits.showcase: A presentation of the project on idem.africa/builders, unless you ask to hide it.
translations.buildersTerms.benefits.portrait: Possibly, a feature on the IDEM blog, social networks or newsletters, chosen by the team and prepared with you.
translations.buildersTerms.benefits.badge: The right to display the Idem Builder badge, under section 7.
translations.buildersTerms.benefits.rules.title: Rules that apply to every credit
translations.buildersTerms.benefits.rules.content: Credits granted by the programme are spent on IDEM services only. They cannot be converted into cash, transferred to another account or refunded. IDEM may change the benefits for the future with 30 days notice; credits already granted remain yours, except in case of fraud (section 9).
translations.buildersTerms.showcase.content: To present your project, you grant IDEM a non-exclusive, free and worldwide licence to reproduce and show, on idem.africa, the IDEM blog, social networks, newsletters and presentations about the programme: its name, its description, its country and city, its public address, your display name as the person behind it, the text in which you present it, the cover image you upload, if any, and its brand identity as created in IDEM (logo, colours, typefaces). Without an uploaded cover, the project page composes one from that identity. This licence lasts for your membership; content already published (blog posts, past newsletters) may stay online as an archive. Any other element (screenshots, quotes, photographs) is only used with your explicit agreement, given for each feature.
translations.buildersTerms.showcase.team.title: Your team on the project page
translations.buildersTerms.showcase.team.content: The members of the team, as entered in the IDEM project (name, role, short biography, photograph, professional links), appear on the project page only if you choose it when you apply. By making that choice, you confirm that each person shown has agreed to it. You can withdraw that choice at any time by writing to us; the team then disappears from the page. Email addresses are never published.
translations.buildersTerms.showcase.cover.title: The cover image you upload
translations.buildersTerms.showcase.cover.content: By uploading a cover, you confirm that you hold the rights to it and that it shows nothing unlawful, misleading or that infringes the rights of others (in particular the image rights of the people shown). IDEM resizes it and removes its metadata, and may remove it from the page at any time if it breaks these rules; the composed cover then takes its place.
translations.buildersTerms.showcase.badge.title: The Idem Builder badge
translations.buildersTerms.showcase.badge.content: While you are a member, IDEM grants you a personal, free and revocable right to display the badge on the channels of the admitted project, without altering it. The badge says that the project belongs to the programme; it is not a certification, a guarantee or an endorsement of your products by IDEM, and must not be presented as such. You remove it within 15 days of leaving the programme.
translations.buildersTerms.commitments.content: As a member, you undertake to:
translations.buildersTerms.commitments.lawful: keep the project lawful and compliant with the IDEM Terms of Service;
translations.buildersTerms.commitments.inform: tell IDEM about any major change: change of activity, closure, transfer of the project;
translations.buildersTerms.commitments.fair: not obtain benefits unfairly: several accounts for the same person, fictitious projects, top-ups made on behalf of third parties;
translations.buildersTerms.commitments.badge: use the IDEM name and badge only as these terms allow.
translations.buildersTerms.exit.content: Membership has no fixed term. You can leave the programme at any time by writing to contact@idem.africa; the benefits then stop for the future. IDEM may suspend or end a membership if the project no longer meets the conditions of section 3, or in case of breach of these terms. Except for a serious breach, IDEM first tells you by email and gives you 15 days to put things right. In case of fraud, IDEM may also cancel credits granted by the programme that have not yet been spent.
translations.buildersTerms.ip.content: You keep all rights to your project, its name, its brand and its content; the only right granted to IDEM is the licence in section 7. IDEM keeps all rights to its name, its brands, the name Idem Builders and the badge.
translations.buildersTerms.liability.content: The programme is offered as it is. IDEM does not promise any level of visibility, traffic, sales, revenue or funding. IDEM is not liable for indirect losses, nor for the content of your site or application, even when the showcase links to it. You remain solely responsible for your project, its content and its relations with your own customers. Nothing in these terms limits liability that the law does not allow to be limited.
translations.buildersTerms.changes.content: IDEM may change these terms. Any substantial change is announced by email and in the console at least 30 days before it applies, with its new version number; remaining a member after that date means accepting it, and you may leave before. IDEM may also end the programme with 30 days notice. Credits already granted remain usable under the rules of the IDEM wallet.
translations.buildersTerms.law.content: These terms are governed by the law of Cameroon, including the Uniform Acts of OHADA where they apply. In case of disagreement, write to us first: we look for an amicable solution within 30 days. Failing that, the competent courts of Douala have jurisdiction, subject to the mandatory rules that protect consumers in their country of residence.
translations.buildersTerms.contact.content: Questions about the programme: contact@idem.africa. Legal questions: legal@idem.africa. IDEM, Douala, Cameroon.

translations.journey.intro.title: A real example
translations.journey.intro.body: Awa wants to collect the plastic waste of Douala and sell it back, recycled. No logo, no plan, no website: here is every step of her launch with IDEM.
translations.journey.intro.alt: An entrepreneur with a great idea, ready to start her business
translations.journey.end.title: Verda is a real company
translations.journey.end.body: Registered, online, and able to walk into a bank with a file that holds up. It all started with one sentence — and Awa never wrote a line of code.
translations.journey.end.note: Free to start · no card required
translations.journey.end.alt: An entrepreneur holding up a trophy, surrounded by the pieces of her business

translations.journey.step.name: The name
translations.journey.name.title: Her business has a name: Verda
translations.journey.name.caption: A logo, colours, business cards. Enough to introduce herself to a customer on day one.
translations.journey.name.alt: The Verda brand book: logo, colour palette and typography

translations.journey.site.title: Her website builds itself in front of her
translations.journey.site.caption: She describes what she wants in one sentence. Companies can book a collection online.

translations.simulation.cta.body: Before you commit your time and your money, find out under what conditions your business can work and what could make it fail.
translations.simulation.entry.title: Two ways to start
translations.simulation.entry.project.title: From an IDEM project
translations.simulation.entry.project.body: Business plan, market analysis, financial forecasts and business model are already there. The engine has less to ask for, and you pay less.
translations.simulation.entry.import.title: By importing your business plan
translations.simulation.entry.import.body: PDF, DOCX or plain text. IDEM extracts the activity, market, target customer, prices and costs, then lets you fill in the gaps before you start.
translations.simulation.offers.title: What you are buying
translations.simulation.offers.body: Simulation is billed separately from the rest of IDEM: it spends external research, several agents and compute. The amount is shown and confirmed before anything starts.
translations.simulation.offers.run.name: Simulation
translations.simulation.offers.run.body: The scenarios, the deciding factors, the major risks and the viability index.
translations.simulation.offers.pack.name: Simulation + report
translations.simulation.offers.pack.body: The simulation and its full report, cheaper than buying both separately.
translations.simulation.offers.report.name: Full report
translations.simulation.offers.report.body: The detailed analysis and recommendations, for a simulation you already ran.
translations.simulation.evidence.title: Every figure says where it came from
translations.simulation.evidence.body: Observed data, a derived estimate and an assumption are not worth the same. Blurring them would give a false impression of precision.
translations.simulation.evidence.data.label: Data
translations.simulation.evidence.data.body: An observed, published figure with its source and its date. Fuel prices, urban density, exchange rates.
translations.simulation.evidence.estimate.label: Estimate
translations.simulation.evidence.estimate.body: A value derived from comparable data, when nothing direct exists for your market.
translations.simulation.evidence.assumption.label: Assumption
translations.simulation.evidence.assumption.body: A deliberate choice by the engine, flagged as such, because no reliable data was available.
translations.simulation.wall.title: A business does not run on five variables
translations.simulation.wall.body: It runs on dozens, sometimes hundreds of factors, and they are never quite the same from one project to the next.
translations.simulation.wall.badge.label: factors typically identified on a single project, before a single scenario is run.
translations.simulation.wall.more: and many more, depending on your sector
translations.simulation.hero.title: Test your business before you {$START_TAG_SPAN}launch{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN} it
translations.simulation.hero.description: An idea can look excellent on paper and still fail once it meets the market. IDEM looks for the factors that can genuinely influence your business, simulates several possible futures, and shows you where your model breaks.
translations.simulation.fan.title: Fan of simulated trajectories
translations.simulation.fan.desc: From a single project, the engine lets many trajectories diverge. A minority stay above the viability threshold; most fall below it.
translations.simulation.honesty.title: What iSimulator does not promise you
translations.simulation.honesty.p1: The results are estimates based on the data, assumptions and scenarios available at the time of analysis.
translations.simulation.honesty.p2: A high index guarantees neither viability, nor profitability, nor the long-term survival of your business. A low index does not mean the project is impossible: it means that, in the scenarios that were run, some factors carry significant risk.
translations.simulation.honesty.p3: It is a decision-support tool. Not a prediction, not a guarantee.
translations.simulation.loop.title: A simulation is not an endpoint
translations.simulation.loop.body: Change your price, your target customer or your funding in IDEM, run it again, and compare the two versions. What moves is not your chance of succeeding: it is how much strain your model takes.
translations.simulation.loop.caption: Each new run is kept, so you can compare versions instead of arguing about them.
translations.simulation.how.title: What IDEM does when you start a simulation
translations.simulation.how.body: This is not a conversation with an AI. It is a five-stage analysis.
translations.simulation.how.card.body: Several agents work in parallel: one reads the project, others research external data, another combines them into scenarios.
translations.simulation.pipeline.read.title: Reading the project
translations.simulation.pipeline.read.body: IDEM builds a structured picture of your project, separating what it knows from what it has to research, what stays uncertain, and what is missing.
translations.simulation.pipeline.discover.title: Factor discovery
translations.simulation.pipeline.discover.body: Agents look for the factors that can actually move this particular business, then rank them as critical, important, secondary or uncertain.
translations.simulation.pipeline.research.title: Data research
translations.simulation.pipeline.research.body: Prices, density, costs, regulation, seasonality: every external value arrives with its source, its date and how much confidence it carries.
translations.simulation.pipeline.simulate.title: Simulation
translations.simulation.pipeline.simulate.body: The engine combines factors and runs baseline, favourable and adverse scenarios, stress tests, and rare compound shocks.
translations.simulation.pipeline.analyse.title: Analysis
translations.simulation.pipeline.analyse.body: Viability index, robustness, confidence level, breaking points, the conditions viability depends on, and recommendations ranked by priority.
translations.simulation.readout.title: An index, never on its own
translations.simulation.readout.body: An index of 72 backed by solid data and an index of 72 riddled with uncertainty do not mean the same thing. IDEM always shows both together.
translations.simulation.readout.robustness.def: How well the model keeps holding as the factors deteriorate.
translations.simulation.readout.confidence.def: The quality of the data the analysis rests on, assumptions included.
translations.simulation.readout.uncertainties.def: What the simulation could not establish, and what still has to be checked on the ground.
translations.simulation.readout.card.label: Simulated viability index
translations.simulation.readout.card.caveat: This index measures how robust the project is across the scenarios that were run. It is not a prediction of success.
translations.simulation.report.title: The report answers one question
translations.simulation.report.body: What could make this project succeed or fail, and what should I change?
translations.simulation.report.note: Not "improve your marketing". Rather: acquisition cost is the model's main weakness, test an organic channel before raising the ad budget. Expected impact high, priority critical, confidence medium.
translations.simulation.report.image.alt: A simulation report opened in IDEM, showing the financial summary and its indicators
translations.simulation.report.caption: The report is delivered inside your project, next to the deliverables it was built from.
translations.simulation.report.s4: Scenarios, stress tests and extreme cases
translations.simulation.report.s10: What to validate in the real world
translations.simulation.sectors.title: Factors depend on the business, not on a template
translations.simulation.sectors.body: Two businesses, two worlds. A fixed list of twenty variables applied to everyone would describe neither of them properly.
